verdict.rationale: Portkey supports declarative rules that fire automatically on request-level events. Fallbacks trigger on configurable status codes (`on_status_codes`), conditional routing sends requests to different targets, budget thresholds send notifications and block further usage, and guardrails can filter, fix, or route requests in real time. These rules are limited to gateway concerns rather than general event-driven automation. Missing for 10: general-purpose event→action rule builder, webhooks or custom action triggers to external systems, depth of docs on authoring conditional rules, independent or hands-on corroboration.
